question: True or false: with [roomId, serverUrl] as deps, a re-created options object with the same values won't reconnect.
say: True or false: with room id and server URL as dependencies, a re-created options object with the same values will not reconnect.
explanation: True. Strings compare by content, so equal values mean the Effect is skipped.
explainSay: True. Strings with the same content compare as equal.
